info.name: Minhaj API

item.name: 0. Quick start

request.description:
Registers a fresh student (the email is generated per run in the pre-request script) and stores accessToken/refreshToken.

Rate limited (10 requests/min per IP).
Logs in again and refreshes the stored tokens. Limited to 5 attempts/min per email + IP.

exec: pm.test('At least one published course exists', function () { pm.expect(_c.length).to.be.above(0); });

request.description: Public. Stores the id of the first course as courseId. Needs at least one published course: an admin creates and publishes one (Admin / Instructor folders), or use seed data if the app runs with the optional `demo` profile.
Requires a verified email (403 otherwise). See 'Verify email' above.

item.name: Auth

request.description: Creates a STUDENT and returns tokens. 409 if the email exists.
Stores instructorAccessToken. Promote a user first with 'Update user role' (INSTRUCTOR).
Refresh tokens are single use: the response contains a new pair, stored automatically.
Revokes the refresh token.
Always answers 200 so it does not reveal whether the email exists.
Replace the token with the one from the reset link. A wrong token gives 400.

item.description: Rate limited (login 5/min per email+IP, others 10/min per IP).

request.description: Published courses only. sortBy: createdAt (default), relevance (with search), price, rating, title... Enable optional filters by ticking them.
Drafts are only visible to their instructor and admins (send a token).
